notes.page_content: One landscape handwritten sheet of Hom/P expressions, a disk-and-loop sketch at left, a right-hand arrow diagram, and three lower geometrical sketches. Archive numeral 10 is at lower left.
notes.author_uncertainty: The written question mark is immediately above the similarity sign in the top expression. No prose uncertainty words appear on this page.
notes.title_date_page_counts: No title, date or manuscript page numeral was read. Archive sheet 10 is recorded only as a comment. H page 10 is the packet page reference; scan number is 11.
notes.workflow: Current UTC start recorded before packet reading. Read C, H, metadata, doubts, notes, inventory, preamble and supplied notation. Packet notation and the supplied notation snapshot were byte-identical. Opened the whole scan once, each half once, then each of sixteen local crops once. No further broad image views were made.
notes.image_coordinates: Full scan 1678 x 1206. Both supplied halves are 899 x 1206; left half origin is (0,0), right half origin is (779,0). All report crop boxes use full-scan coordinates and upper-left origin.

source_doubt_accounting.row_3_scope: The source context explicitly contrasts the rounded left product with the angular right product. Both are locally reported. Later Z-like forms are audited as recurrences in notation and reading.md; they are not silently added as new source doubts.
source_doubt_accounting.row_7_scope: The live outer operator and the small first inner argument are independent subloci, A07a and A07b. The central E recurrence was separately inspected in crop 08 and entered in notation, not counted as an additional source doubt.
source_doubt_accounting.row_14_scope: Lower object V/W and the lowered product index are distinct physical regions, with their own crops 14 and 13.

notes.apparatus: The seven C notation rows, two Slips retained rows and Hom abbreviation row are kept in their categories. C_notes contains the author question mark. H notes and drawing descriptions are apparatus; their words are not manuscript prose and are not counted as text-not-on-page. Their actual readings, punctuation, states and described drawing details are collated. E script-font macro choice alone has no H difference count.
notes.mathematics_led_reading: Read all arguments, arrows, inclusions and delimiters as written. The E,Z inner order and the two single terminal closures were decided from strokes. No adjunction identity, classification, algebraic repair or proof was used to decide the ink. Actual mathematical check_events is empty.
notes.graphic_annotation: The cancelled Hom cluster and right diagram use explicit TikZ paths and invisible deleted boxing to retain deletion annotations without imposing generic horizontal strokes. The raised M/U and R state qualifications are local. The upper drawing and lower three-sketch paths were checked against the page before reusing C paths. New small paths and altered local geometry are reported separately.
notes.crop_limits: Every target mark fits its planned crop. Crops 05 and 06 overlap because the crossed cluster and live line are distinct adjacent targets; neither was recropped. The two drawing-detail crops intentionally stop through long contextual curves outside their target marks; those full curves had already been read in the halves. The complete lower disk stem endpoint is inside crop 16. Top-edge sign uncertainty includes the physical sheet edge, which a crop cannot recover.
notes.validation: Structural source checks only; no compiler, format builder, package installation, PDF generation or render validation was performed.
